# TinySoundFont

Unmodified `tsf.h` and LICENSE from <https://github.com/schellingb/TinySoundFont>, commit `853a0a171759f1ddba0de1442133a75912bbeffa` (MIT). No example sound banks imported. Adaptation, bounded file streaming, lifetime management and preallocated voices live in `src/soundfont.cpp`. The test/factory bank is locally generated, not an external asset.
